title: Ops Accelerator: Admin utility orchestration and taskified runbook framework
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "ops accelerator" that consolidates lightweight admin utilities and exposes them as first-class, taskified runbook steps. The goal is to reduce mean time to remediate common infra problems and make on-call flows reproducible: expose audit-safe primitives (inspect KV cache, force-evict sessions, resync model routing rules, and generate token-usage snapshots) and a framework to compose these into tasks with approvals, dry-run, and post-run artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: 3 admin utilities implemented and documented (kv-cache-inspector, token-usage-aggregator, emergency-evict)
A2: Each utility can be executed via Tasks UI or CLI with --dry-run and --audit-log flags
A3: Runbooks can be authored as ordered sequences of tasks with optional manual approval steps
A4: All task executions produce a standard JSON artifact that is stored in the ops audit bucket and linked to the incident timeline
A5: Safety gating: emergency-evict requires 2-button confirm or SSO approval for production namespaces
comments: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket to consolidate recurring admin scripts we keep copy-pasting across oncall. Initial scope proposes 3 utilities + task framework MVP.

2025-02-14 - Marco Ruiz: Spike completed for kv-cache-inspector prototype (see link). Observed that reading large KV pages times out at 45s on some clusters; will add pagination and rate limit to prevent serving impact.

2025-02-17 - SRE sync: Decided to prefer read-only inspection by default; mutate actions require explicit --evict flag and higher approval. Trade-off: slower remediation for certain incidents vs preventing accidental mass evictions.
2025-02-19 - Design review (Elena Morris): Proposed small UI for task composition, including templated steps. Need to add a short help flow for junior oncall.

2025-02-22 - Marco Ruiz: Opened draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-accelerator/pull/12. PR implements token-usage-aggregator and basic task runner. Requesting review from @sre-team and @security.
2025-02-24 - Security review: flagged KMS integration for audit artifact encryption. Marked security_review_required=true and added dependency on eng/KMS integration ticket.
2025-02-28 - Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to require standard JSON artifact schema and retention policy (90 days). Added due date for MVP demo in next oncall rotation.
notes: MVP focuses on non-blocking safety and auditability rather than full automation breadth. Future phases will add scheduler integration, playbook templates per incident type, and RBAC scoping by team. Avoid creating heavyweight orchestration in MVP; keep each task idempotent and short-lived.
manual_steps: Step 2: If suspect entries found, open task with context + screenshot and require SSO approval for prod
Step 3: Run emergency-evict --selector <label> with 2-button confirm; document reason and select retention duration
